name: megascenes-book-cover
description: Design book and ebook covers with your title and author name set in the design, for novels, guides and children's books.

interface.longDescription:
Give the title, the author, the genre and an image idea, and get a book cover with the text in the design, in the tall format books use.

ChatGPT tells you what the run needs and creates the cover in your MegaScenes account when you ask. The cover opens in the chat and stays in your library.

For self-published authors, newsletters and book clubs.

Limitations: front covers as image files; it does not lay out the spine and back cover or publish the book. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content or for real people's likeness. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.
capabilities: Design book covers with your title
Return the cover in the chat
defaultPrompt: A cover for The Salt Road by Mara Quinn, a historical novel
A thriller cover for Night Shift by J. Ellis, dark city street
A children's book cover for The Brave Little Cloud

positive.prompt: A book cover for The Salt Road by Mara Quinn, a historical novel, a caravan in the desert. Tell me what it needs, but don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one cover needs from the account. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: A thriller cover for Night Shift by J. Ellis, a dark city street in the rain. Don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one cover needs. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Which models can design a book cover here?
positive.expected_behavior: The book cover models with their settings. Nothing is created.

positive.description: Make it after an explicit request
positive.prompt: A children's book cover for The Brave Little Cloud by Lia Moreno, soft pastel sky. Create it now.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says what the run needs and, once the person confirms, one job starts in the signed-in MegaScenes account; the status tool reports progress and, when it succeeds, returns the file link, which the result view shows.

positive.prompt: Which MegaScenes account am I signed in with?
positive.expected_behavior: The email and plan of the signed-in account. Nothing is created.

negative.prompt: Print my book cover on 50 mugs and ship them to my office in Berlin.
Email my book cover to my client at sam@example.com.
What is the capital of Portugal?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Making a file runs in the user's existing MegaScenes account; no purchase happens in the conversation.

publication.release_notes: Name only: the brand suffix is gone from the plugin name. No change to the tools, the server or the listing text.
